title: Juicy Croatian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Croatian dish featuring lamb shanks, this stew is perfect for a cozy evening, served in a vibrant talavera plate. The double fry method gives the lamb a crispy exterior and a tender interior.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Add the lamb shanks and brown them on all sides, about 5 minutes, then remove them from the pot.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot, and stir to combine.
Return the lamb shanks to the pot, and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the heat, and let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs, in a talavera plate.
